{{External|rs}} {{HasTask|Rats|Zombies}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = 1 |version2 = 2 |version3 = 3 |name = Zombie rat |image1 = [[File:Zombie rat (1).png|200px]] |image2 = [[File:Zombie rat (2).png|200px]] |image3 = [[File:Zombie rat (3).png|200px]] |release = [[23 September]] [[2001]] |update = Dragon quest online! |members = No |combat = 3 |size1 = 2 |size2 = 2 |size3 = 1 |examine = Overgrown undead vermin. |attributes = rat, undead |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 1 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 30 |slayxp = 2 |cat = Rats, Zombies |assignedby = turael,spria |hitpoints = 5 |att = 2 |str = 3 |def = 2 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 50 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id1 = 3969 |id2 = 3970 |id3 = 3971 }} A '''zombie rat''' is a [[Monsters|monster]] only found in [[Melzar's Maze]]. It comes in two sizes, but both have the same stats. It is quite similar to the [[giant rat]] except with a few cuts, gashes, and a washed-out colour. The small zombie rat with a long tail is the only variant that will drop the [[Key (red)|red key]]. Players may choose to equip a [[salve amulet]] for a combat bonus against this creature. According to [[Melzar's notes]], zombie rats are the result of [[Melzar the Mad|Melzar]]'s first experiments with [[necromancy]] in his efforts to resurrect the dead [[Crandor]]ians that were slain by [[Elvarg]]. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Zombie rat |location = [[Melzar's Maze]] |levels = 3 |members = No |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:2925,y:3256|x:2928,y:3244|x:2930,y:3252|x:2931,y:3249|x:2933,y:3244|x:2934,y:3254|x:2935,y:3248 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Asgarnia }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Drops== ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsLine|name=Key (red)|quantity=1|rarity=Always|raritynotes=Only dropped by the small rat with a long tail.|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} {{Reflist|group=d}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Giant rat bone|quantity=1|rarity=Always|raritynotes=Giant rat bones are dropped only during [[Rag and Bone Man I]].|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} {{Reflist|group=d}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat |change = Zombie rats now have a 50% elemental weakness to [[fire spells]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 18 October 2006 |update = Player-Owned House Costume Room |change = The NPCs were graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 September 2005 |update = New graphics for Port Sarim, Rimmington and Thurgo's Peninsula |change = *The NPC was graphically updated with the rework of Rimmington. *The NPC's combat level was decreased from 6 to 3. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== 1= {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Zombie rat (historical v1).png|200x150px]] |[[File:Zombie rat (1) (historical).png|200x150px]] |[[File:Zombie rat (1).png|200x150px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
